title: Rental shortages in Paris and other major French cities are hitting all social classes
subhead: The shortage of housing for rent is so severe that even white-collar professionals are struggling to find apartments. Real estate professionals blame higher interest rates, energy efficiency requirements and the end of a tax incentive scheme for landlords.

'A debt can be erased, but the decisions that created it always have to be paid for in one way or another'
subhead: Hard-left candidate Jean-Luc Mélenchon has successfully brought the public debt issue into the presidential election campaign by proposing to cancel part of it. The proposal is legally fragile and does not address France's persistent budget deficit, writes Le Monde columnist Stéphane Lauer.

title: ICE agent shoots and wounds man in Texas
subhead: An immigration agent shot a Venezuelan man in the torso during a DoorDash food delivery on Sunday afternoon. According to the man's lawyer, he has since been taken out of the hospital and been placed in ICE custody. 'If ICE deports him, the key witness to their shooting disappears,' said Congressman Greg Casar.

title: The artist's creative process revealed in 'Andy Warhol: Line and Image'
subhead: Paris's Musée du Luxembourg has brought together around 200 works – drawings, lithographs, photographs and films – that shed light on how the New York-based artist worked.

title: Gaza's women are the only ones keeping their families alive: 'I had to keep going to find food for the children'
subhead: The war waged by Israel has upended the structures of families in Gaza, where women now head nearly one in four households. Tens of thousands of Palestinian women have been left alone to feed their children and seek help and shelter in a dangerous environment.

title: Paris's Techno Parade turns up volume to protest law targeting free parties
subhead: After a two-year hiatus, the festive protest returned Saturday afternoon in a cheerful atmosphere. Organizers and participants voiced criticism of the Ripost law adopted this summer that imposes harsher penalties on self-organized raves.
